source: The Qualtrics features surveytwin reads, and what it does with each

levels.Partial: common cases executed, named edge cases simplified
levels.Not supported: found and reported; the question gets a blank column and is never shown to a twin

features.feature: Multiple choice, single and multiple answer
features.what_the_library_does: Multiple answer becomes one yes/no question per option; text-entry options become extra open questions

features.feature: Text entry (single line, essay, form field)
features.what_the_library_does: One open question each; form fields split into one question per field (form field: Partial)
Shown as context, never asked

features.feature: Matrix (Likert, bipolar, profile, multiple answer, text entry, constant sum rows)
features.what_the_library_does: One question per row, or per row and column; MaxDiff and rank-order matrices simplified
One numeric question per statement, with range, step and decimals enforced
One unique-rank question per item
One question per column and row, each column with its own scale
Answers rescaled to the total; input style not distinguished
Skipped; no timings or device data invented

features.feature: Conjoint block: generated designs (random valid profiles) or supplied ones, generic or fixed alternatives, level weights, applicability matrices, forbidden combinations, duplicate rules, attribute and alternative order, an outside option
features.what_the_library_does: Each twin's tasks are drawn from the run's seed and kept; each task shows its alternatives as a table (or a list), level pictures in their cells; one choice per task, all tasks of a block in one model call by default (or one task per call); what each twin was shown is recorded and exported

features.feature: MaxDiff block: uniform or balanced item subsets, or supplied ones, item order, best and worst labels, an anchored follow-up
features.what_the_library_does: Best and worst are asked together and must differ, checked after the answers come back; a pair naming one item twice is recorded as skipped for a rerun to ask again (never asked again during the run); what each twin was shown is recorded and exported

features.feature: Net Promoter Score, pick-group-rank, drill down, heat map, hot spot, signature, file upload, calendar, map, highlight, video, tree testing, Qualtrics conjoint and MaxDiff projects (a QSF does not hold their designs)
features.what_the_library_does: Reported; blank column
Random order, subsets, reversal, fixed and randomized slots; reversal groups are reported, not executed
Conditions on embedded data resolve up front; conditions on answers resolve in staged runs

Applied in both run modes: an option, matrix statement, scale point or text-entry form field is shown only when its condition holds, and a question left with none is not shown; a condition on an answer makes the survey staged. Not applied to the rows of a side-by-side question
Single-choice selected / not selected rules jumping forward, to end of block, or to end of survey
Logic uses authored IDs; recodes apply only in the values export
Shown to the twin as the pre-filled value; never substituted for a skipped answer
Count, numeric, rank, sum and length rules shown in the prompt and enforced after the answer; custom validation reported
Reported; only works when the QSF already lists the final choices
Reported, never run
Reported; the default language only
Names the export columns
From the survey flow
Basic shuffle executed; advanced page and group settings reported
Static loop tables expanded, every row, with row randomization and subsets; loops over contacts or answers not supported
A block is one sequence in the prompt
Set in flow order, including values set inside branches and randomizer arms; a field never set on a twin's path renders blank
Conditions on answers and embedded data with common operators; quota, device, contact, scoring and custom sources reported
Independent seeded arms per twin, or balanced schedules when evenly presented
Containment
Ends the twin's survey; screenout labels and redirects not acted on
Never called; fields it would set stay unresolved

features.feature: Authenticator, table of contents, quota, reference survey, supplemental data, conjoint group, experience agent
features.what_the_library_does: Reported
Resolved in flow order; fields from URLs or contact lists can be supplied with configure(embedded_data=...)
Resolved for static loop tables

Resolved from the twin's own answers in staged runs: selected, unselected, displayed and all choices, recodes, counts, text and number entries, matrix answers; other forms are named by check(); an answer the data holds no answer for (flagged) pipes blank. The values file codes an answer by the option chosen among those shown, so an option that pipes is coded too
Integer, decimal (13 places) and true/false (1 or 0), drawn per twin and place from the run seed, the same in static and staged runs; any other form is reported and left as written

features.feature: Dates, location, scoring, quotas, contact fields, math $e{...}
features.what_the_library_does: Reported; left as literal text

features.feature: Images in questions, choices, rows, statements and text blocks
features.what_the_library_does: Sent to the model with labels; unreachable images stop the run unless the caller accepts running without them
